title: task-pipeline execution packet
description: The family's versioned task/context contract (CTX-01). One packet is one dispatchable unit of work: what to do, under which module decisions, reading which inputs, inside which budget. Packets are IMMUTABLE once issued — a change is a new packet with a new id, never an edit. What ships is this schema, one example, and `scripts/packet.py`, the dependency-free validator every consumer runs before acting: a packet whose mandatory version major is unknown, whose input lacks a digest, or whose decision ref is unbound must be rejected at the door, because acting on a packet you could not verify is how two agents build different things from one plan.

schema_version.description: Contract version, `execution-packet/<major>`. A consumer that does not know the major REJECTS the packet — an unknown mandatory version is not a warning.

id.description: Stable packet id. Immutable: revising the work issues a new id.

parent_id.description: The parent outcome or plan node this packet serves, when one exists.

module.description: The owning module/repository the packet's edits belong to.

intent.description: One sentence of what this packet changes and why — the contract, not the diff.

inputs.description: Every context document the work READS. Each is content-addressed: an input without a digest cannot be verified fresh, so it does not dispatch.

decision_refs.description: The module decisions this packet is bound by. BOUND means address+digest present — a decision named without its bytes is a rumour, and the packet is rejected.

edit_targets.description: The exact files the packet may change. A baseline digest per Edit target is what makes 'the source moved under the plan' detectable before dispatch.

claim.description: The coordination scope to claim before editing, where the project has agent-sync on.

token_note.description: How tokens were measured or estimated — a named tokenizer or the estimate's basis. A bare token count nothing computed is not a budget.

budgets.description: At least one bound. Budgets cut appendix material, never the packet's decisions or acceptance.

acceptance.description: Observable acceptance cases. Never truncated to fit a budget.

address.description: Where the bytes live: a repo-relative path or a portable `scheme://` address.

sha256.description: Digest of the exact bytes the plan was made against. Freshness is checked against this before dispatch; a mismatch blocks, it never silently becomes permission to use stale context.

baseline_sha256.description: Required when mode is Edit: the bytes the plan reviewed. Creates have no baseline.
